sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders are in excellent form with five consecutive wins in their last six outings and will be heavily favoured against Alsager, who occupy the bottom half of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town, looking to maintain pressure on Sandbach after drawing their last match. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth face a stern test away at Eccleshall, who sit fifth and recently recovered from a loss with a win. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter. Bilston Town welcome struggling Foley Meir, with both teams occupying the lower-middle reaches but Bilston showing stronger recent form. In-form Barnton host Shawbury United, who are in poor shape with just one win in their last five; Crewe travel to face Allscott Heath in a battle of teams both searching for consistency; Market Drayton Town, also searching for form after recent losses, head to face fellow strugglers New Mills; and Brereton Social entertain bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town, whose alarming record shows no wins and a goal difference of minus 23. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a clash between two of the division's weakest-performing sides this season.
